scope: SPEC0209 bounded static reference catalog acceptance only

findings.title: Executable implementation stored as a string is copied into contract data
findings.impact: Frozen raw catalog vendors 39,615 characters of executable workflow guest implementation (79 functions with bodies), violating the bodies-exclusion/static-contract-only requirement even though the entry remains UNKNOWN.
findings.recommendation: Allowlist contract literal data and represent source-code payloads by UNKNOWN plus source/payload hashes and ownership; do not copy their bytes. Add an executable-string negative fixture and regenerate affected artifacts without shrinking the denominator.

findings.title: Git status executes reference-configured fsmonitor command
findings.impact: Collector can execute arbitrary commands configured in the reference repository during a nominally static/read-only collection. Synthetic tracked shell hook executed and catalog returned NOT_VERIFIED successfully.
findings.recommendation: Disable core.fsmonitor explicitly for every Git invocation and isolate any other repository-configured execution mechanisms; retain an independent known-bad command-execution fixture.

findings.title: Existing external output hardlink overwrites tracked reference source
findings.impact: Path/symlink checks pass for an external hardlink, then writeFileSync truncates its shared inode and replaces a reference manifest with catalog JSON; CLI exits 0. The read-only reference guarantee fails.
findings.recommendation: Write to a newly created exclusive temporary file outside the reference and atomically replace the output directory entry after path checks, or reject multiply linked existing files. Add a hardlink regression checking unchanged reference bytes.

findings.title: Git replacement refs substitute a different tree beneath the expected commit pin
findings.impact: rev-parse HEAD preserves the expected SHA while ls-tree/status honor refs/replace. Collector accepts changed source and records original expected pin despite a different tree. Existing authentic freeze still rejects the difference; initial pin authentication does not.
findings.recommendation: Set GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 or use --no-replace-objects for all Git operations; test replacement of a pinned commit/tree while preserving HEAD and manifest owner hashes.
